name: slack-e2e
description: Real-user Playwright Slack E2E suite. Drives the gardenio Slack surface as a dedicated TEST human user (app.slack.com) against a dedicated test workspace/app wired to the ephemeral slack-bridge under test, and asserts the controller/bridge react end-to-end over Socket Mode. Sibling to gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-e2e/. Env contract is handed in by gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/test-slack-ui.sh (module slack-ui).
